name: g_fsTransferPriorityTable
comment: Mode-to-channel enablement table for filesystem background transfer; defines whether each of the 12 transfer channels is active for modes 0 through 4 (12 channels x 5 bytes = 60 bytes).
evidence: Read by maybe_Fs_SetTransferPriority (0x001068AC) via literal 0x00106A0C; 60 bytes loaded as 15 words into stack, indexed by mode + channel * 5 for 12 channels.

name: g_nimAocServiceName
comment: Service port name string "nim:aoc" (Network Information Management - Add-On Content); passed to Os_CreateEvent in Fs_MountDefaultArchives to enable DLC archive mounting.
evidence: Literal 0x001042AC in Fs_MountDefaultArchives (0x00104240); 8-byte null-terminated ASCII string 'nim:aoc' in rodata.

name: g_fsUserServiceName
comment: Service port name string "fs:USER" (3DS filesystem user service); passed to srvGetServiceHandle in Fs_Initialize to obtain the primary filesystem IPC session handle.
evidence: Literal 0x00106B74 in Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0); 8-byte null-terminated string 'fs:USER' in rodata passed to srvGetServiceHandle (0x001192C0).

name: g_fsEmptyMountName
comment: Empty fallback mount name string ("\0"); parsed by Fs_RegisterMountByName and Fs_UnmountByName as a dummy device name when the provided name fails initial validation.
evidence: Literals 0x00106D4C in Fs_UnmountByName (0x00106BFC) and 0x0010B81C in Fs_RegisterMountByName (0x0010B6D4); points to 0x00 followed by 0xFF padding, read as an 8-byte name buffer.

name: g_amAppServiceName
comment: Service port name string "am:app" (3DS Application Manager); passed to srvGetServiceHandle in maybe_Fs_OpenGlobalFile to connect to the AM service session.
evidence: Literal 0x00106ABC in maybe_Fs_OpenGlobalFile (0x00106A70); 7-byte null-terminated string 'am:app' in rodata passed to srvGetServiceHandle (0x001192C0).

name: g_fsChannelTableVtableAlt
comment: Primary vtable header for FsChannelTable; installed at self (with secondary vtable at offset +0x18) by maybe_Fs_ChannelTable_Create before constructing 0xFF 24-byte channel entries.
evidence: Literal 0x00103714 in maybe_Fs_ChannelTable_Create (0x00103594); 7 words in rodata with offset-to-top 0xFFFFFFFC at +0x10 and secondary vtable at +0x18 (0x007602CC). [renamed by orchestrator 2026-11-05: duplicate of G_013 name at 0x0078295C]

name: g_fsArchiveVtable
comment: Base vtable of the archive object (FsArchive / SoundArchive); installed at self[0] by constructor 0x00542B98 and restored by destructor 0x00542BCC.
evidence: Literals 0x00542BC8 and 0x00542BD8 in Fs_Archive_Close / dtor (0x00542B48) and 0x00549B00; word 0 is code pointer 0x00542BCC which restores this vtable and returns.

name: g_fsArchiveStreamVtable
comment: Vtable of the archive stream object (FsArchiveStream); installed at self[0] by constructors maybe_Fs_ArchiveStream_Create and maybe_Fs_ArchiveStream_CreateFromStream.
evidence: Literals 0x00548604 and 0x005487A0 in constructors 0x00548488 and 0x00548610; stored into self[0] right after allocating stack frames.

name: g_fsCacheSubAllocVtable
comment: Secondary allocator interface vtable; stored at offset +8 (puVar4[2]) of the 48-byte cache controller object by Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); contains slots for SmallBlockAlloc and HeapAlloc.
evidence: Literal 0x00103FBC in Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); stored into puVar4[2] of 0x30-byte allocation; vtable words 4 and 5 point to SmallBlockAlloc and HeapAlloc.

name: g_fsCacheControllerRefVtable
comment: Vtable of the 8-byte cache-controller reference wrapper stored at self+4; installed by Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); word 0 is destructor 0x00566608.
evidence: Literal 0x00103FC0 in Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); written to word 0 of 8-byte object at self+4 whose word 1 references self+8.

name: g_fsHandleArrayVtable
comment: Vtable of the FsHandleArray wrapper object; installed at self[0] by Fs_Cache_SetHandleArray (0x00108574) when wrapping a fixed handle list for the cache manager.
evidence: Literal 0x00108620 in Fs_Cache_SetHandleArray (0x00108574); stores 0x0078230C into *self, sets capacity at self[4] and allocates handle array.

name: g_fsCacheAllocDescVtable
comment: Vtable of the 20-byte cache-allocator descriptor stored at self+0x18; installed by Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); slots 0x0056C90C, 0x0056C8F4, etc.
evidence: Literal 0x00103FC4 in Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); installed into 20-byte allocation at self+0x18 with allocator pointer at +0x10.

name: g_fsSlotPool58Vtable
comment: Vtable of the 0x58-byte-record variant of FsSlotPool; installed at self[0] by Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58 and Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58Into when creating a two-level cache slot pool.
evidence: Literals 0x001086C8 in 0x00108624 and 0x0010874C in 0x001086CC; installed as vptr into self[0] before allocating slotCount * 0x58 bytes.

name: g_fsSlotPool54Vtable
comment: Vtable of the 0x54-byte-record variant of FsSlotPool; installed at self[0] by Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54 and Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54Into when creating motion and sound cache pools.
evidence: Literals 0x001087F0 in 0x00108750 and 0x00108874 in 0x001087F4; installed as vptr into self[0] before allocating slotCount * 0x54 bytes.

name: g_fsStreamVtable
comment: Vtable of the file stream object (FsStream); installed by maybe_Fs_Stream_Ctor and restored by maybe_Fs_Stream_Destroy; word 1 is deleting destructor 0x0056EC9C.
evidence: Literals 0x0056EC10 in 0x0056EB8C and 0x0056ED2C in 0x0056EC9C; stored into stream[0]; word 1 is deleting destructor 0x0056EC9C.

name: g_fsStreamReaderVtable
comment: Vtable of the stack stream reader context passed to maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead by Fs_NamedObject_Open (0x0056F7A4); word 3 points to stream read implementation 0x006652AC.
evidence: Literal 0x0056F9A8 in Fs_NamedObject_Open (0x0056F7A4); installed into local_70 before dispatching to FindAndRead; rodata word 3 is 0x006652AC.

name: g_fsCacheControllerVtable
comment: Primary vtable for the 48-byte cache controller object stored at self+8; installed by Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); word 0 is destructor helper 0x006F1D1C.
evidence: Literal 0x00103FB8 in Fs_CacheSet_Initialize (0x00103724); stored into puVar4[0] of 0x30-byte allocation; words 0 and 1 point to SmallBlockAlloc destructor routines.

name: g_fsContentArchiveId
comment: Pointer to default content archive path string "2712327116" at 0x00789DC8; loaded by Fs_Request_Build (0x001D0218) when formatting async file requests.
evidence: Literal 0x001D0334 in Fs_Request_Build (0x001D0218); points to '2712327116' in rodata followed by 'content:'; loaded into local_40 and passed to Fs_Request_WaitForService.

name: g_fsDefaultArchivesMounted
comment: Boolean flag tracking whether default filesystem archives (including the nim:aoc event/service session) are currently mounted; set to 1 by Fs_MountDefaultArchives and cleared by Fs_UnmountDefaultArchives.
evidence: Literals 0x001042A8 in Fs_MountDefaultArchives and 0x001042FC in Fs_UnmountDefaultArchives; byte flag tested and updated to guard idempotent mounting.

name: g_fsPackFormatConfig
comment: Archive package format configuration descriptor; byte 0 is package enable flag, byte 2 is record fast-path flag, word at +4 points to magic string "PACA", and word at +8 points to magic string "PACK".
evidence: Literals 0x00109288 in Snd_UpdateVoiceList, 0x0056F9A4 in NamedObject_Open, and 0x0056FCE0 in ReadRecord; compares archive headers against PACA (+4) and PACK (+8).

name: g_fsUserSession
comment: Filesystem user service session structure; word at offset +4 (0x007AEA3C) holds the 3DS IPC Handle for fs:USER, initialized by Fs_Initialize and queried by maybe_Os_AssertObjectReady.
evidence: Literals 0x00106B78 in Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0) and 0x001170C8 in maybe_Os_AssertObjectReady (0x0011709C); offset +4 is g_fsUserSessionHandle (0x007AEA3C).

name: maybe_g_fsUserSessionSentinel
comment: Sentinel / tagged pointer value (address 0x007AEA39, offset 0x39 or tagged with bit 0); stored into the session list head at 0x007AEA40 during Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0).
evidence: Literal 0x00106B7C in Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0); loaded into r0, added with 7 to yield 0x007AEA40, then stored at *0x007AEA40 and registered through 0x0010B9C0.

name: g_fsUserSessionHandle
comment: 3DS IPC session handle for the fs:USER service; initialized by Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0) via srvGetServiceHandle (func_001192C0).
evidence: Literal 0x00106B6C in Fs_Initialize (0x00106AD0); passed as out-handle pointer (arg0) to srvGetServiceHandle with service name 'fs:USER' (0x0072FC13).

name: g_fsNamedObjectSlotHint
comment: Rotating search index hint (bounded to 0..0x7FF) used to locate the next free entry in the 2048-slot named object table in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4).
evidence: Literal 0x0056F3DC in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4); updated as (*hint + 1) & 0x7FF upon finding a free slot in the 0x800-entry table at 0x007BA2D0.

name: g_fsNamedObjectNextId
comment: Rotating sequence counter used to allocate unique 20-bit IDs for registered named objects in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4); packed into self[0] as id << 12.
evidence: Literal 0x0056F3D4 in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4); incremented modulo 0xFFFFF and stored into self[0] shifted left by 12 bits.

name: g_fsReaderListNeedsInit
comment: One-time initialization flag (initial value 1); cleared to 0 when maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead (0x0056F9AC) sets up the global reader list g_fsReaderList.
evidence: Literals 0x0056FA98 in maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead (0x0056F9AC) and 0x0057029C in Mem_BitmapPool_Init (0x0057010C); guards construction of g_fsReaderListStorage.

name: g_fsReaderList
comment: Pointer to the global reader list head; initialized on first use to point to g_fsReaderListStorage (0x00837130) and traversed by maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead.
evidence: Literals 0x0056FA9C in maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead and 0x005702A0 in Mem_BitmapPool_Init; stores pointer to reader list head and traversed via list node at +8.

name: g_fsNamedObjectDefaultName
comment: Empty string constant ("\0") stored into self[10] as the default category name when a named object is registered in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4).
evidence: Literal 0x0056F3E4 in Fs_NamedObject_Register (0x0056F1F4); points to empty string in data section (0x00 followed by padding), hashed via FNV-1a to initial seed.

name: g_fsRequestBuffer
comment: Shared request work buffer in BSS; formatted with command header and argument descriptors by Fs_BuildRequestArgs and Fs_BuildReadRequestArgs before dispatching to IPC.
evidence: Literals 0x00502F1C, 0x00503880 and 0x00503A74 in Fs_BuildRequestArgs / ReadRequestArgs; 48-byte BSS block ending at 0x007D0030 where argument payload starts.

name: g_fsReadRequestArgs
comment: Shared argument buffer in BSS for async file read operations; populated with 0x44 (68) bytes of request context and argument descriptors by Fs_BuildReadRequestArgs.
evidence: Literals 0x00503A70 and 0x00503B6C in Fs_BuildReadRequestArgs (0x00503888) and maybe_Fs_SubmitReadRequest (0x00503A7C); destination of 0x44-byte memcpy from request work.

name: maybe_g_fsDefaultRecordTable
comment: Default empty record table buffer in BSS; assigned to self->f_18 (with capacity count 0x20) when closing an archive record table in maybe_Fs_Archive_CloseRecordTable (0x00543028).
evidence: Literal 0x005430BC in maybe_Fs_Archive_CloseRecordTable (0x00543028); assigned to self->f_18 when resetting table fields after freeing allocated record blocks.

name: g_fsMountTable
comment: Global filesystem mount table (32 entries of 16 bytes = 512 bytes); stores 8-byte device name, archive object pointer, and mode flags for each mounted archive in Fs_RegisterMountByName.
evidence: Literals 0x00106D50 in Fs_UnmountByName (0x00106BFC) and 0x0010B824 in Fs_RegisterMountByName (0x0010B6D4); indexed as j * 0x10 with loop limit 0x20.

name: g_fsSharedRequestBlock
comment: Shared 156-byte (0x9C) filesystem request block in BSS; filled by Fs_FillRequestBlock with command, payload (0x40 bytes) and argument data (0x44 bytes) and published by Fs_PublishRequest.
evidence: Literals 0x005030FC in maybe_Fs_FillRequestBlock (0x00503084) and 0x00503210 in Fs_PublishRequest (0x005031CC); destination of 0x9C-byte request record memcpy.

name: maybe_g_fsReaderListStorage
comment: Static BSS storage buffer (aligned to 0x00837130 via & ~0xF) hosting the default FsReaderList head; initialized with vtable 0x00782AC0 by maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead.
evidence: Literal 0x0056FAA0 in maybe_Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead (0x0056F9AC); shifted right by 4 and left by 4 to align to 0x00837130, initialized with vtable 0x00782AC0.
